description: Renovate is disabled for this repository. build.gradle uses Gradle's removed jetty plugin and the removed compile/testCompile configurations, so the build cannot run on any current Gradle regardless of dependency versions, and there is no CI to validate a bump against.
The packageRules below are kept as a record of why specific updates were rejected, so they still apply if this is ever re-enabled. See closed PR #3.

packageRules.description: ScalaTest's old milestone naming (2.3.0-SNAP2, -M1, -RC1) is not recognised as a pre-release by Renovate's version comparison, so it gets offered as a stable upgrade. Restrict to plain x.y.z releases.
